This auxiliary replay asserts only the six even algebra statements in FamilyOrbitLocalization, not review completeness or geometry. For every commutative ring A, x in A and N in Nat (including zero), (1-x)*sum_{0<=j<N} x^j = 1-x^N. Define R(u,nu,N) = u*sum_{0<=j<N} (-nu*u)^j. For every commutative ring A, t,u,nu in A and N in Nat with t*u=1 and nu^N=0, (t+nu)*R(u,nu,N)=1; for every v in A with (t+nu)*v=1, v=R(u,nu,N). For every commutative scalar ring K, K-modules V,W,U with additive commutative group structures, finite type J, linear P:V->W and L:W->U, c:J->K and h:J->V, L(sum_j c(j) smul P(h(j))) = sum_j c(j) smul (L compose P)(h(j)). For the same modules and finite J, every linear L:W->U, family of linear D(j):V->W and h:J->V satisfies L(sum_j D(j)(h(j))) = sum_j (L compose D(j))(h(j)). For every commutative K, finite type I with decidable equality, K-modules V_i,W with additive commutative group structures, finite types J_i, multilinear F:(product_i V_i)->W, scalar families c_i:J_i->K and vectors h_i:J_i->V_i, F(i |-> sum_j c_i(j) smul h_i(j)) equals sum_{choice:product_i J_i} (product_i c_i(choice_i)) smul F(i |-> h_i(choice_i)). Empty finite types are included. No nontriviality, characteristic-zero, geometric nilpotence, super-sign, moduli, virtual-class, S/R-factorization or quantization claim is made.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace FamilyOrbitLocalization

theorem finite_geometric_remainder {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (x : A) (N : ℕ) :
    (1 - x) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, x ^ j) = 1 - x ^ N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih, pow_succ]
      ring

def nilpotentResolvent {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (u ν : A) (N : ℕ) : A :=
  u * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (-ν * u) ^ j

theorem nilpotent_resolvent_inverse {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (t u ν : A) (N : ℕ) (hu : t * u = 1) (hν : ν ^ N = 0) :
    (t + ν) * nilpotentResolvent u ν N = 1 := by
  have hx : (-ν * u) ^ N = 0 := by
    calc
      (-ν * u) ^ N = ((-1 : A) * ν * u) ^ N := by congr 1 <;> ring
      _ = 0 := by simp only [mul_pow, hν, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  have ht : (t + ν) * u = 1 - (-ν * u) := by
    rw [add_mul, hu]
    ring
  rw [nilpotentResolvent, ← mul_assoc, ht, finite_geometric_remainder, hx]
  simp

theorem nilpotent_resolvent_unique {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (t u ν v : A) (N : ℕ) (hu : t * u = 1) (hν : ν ^ N = 0)
    (hv : (t + ν) * v = 1) :
    v = nilpotentResolvent u ν N := by
  have hr := nilpotent_resolvent_inverse t u ν N hu hν
  calc
    v = v * 1 := (mul_one v).symm
    _ = v * ((t + ν) * nilpotentResolvent u ν N) := by rw [hr]
    _ = ((t + ν) * v) * nilpotentResolvent u ν N := by ring
    _ = nilpotentResolvent u ν N := by rw [hv, one_mul]

section LinearMoments

variable {K V W U J : Type*} [CommRing K]
variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
variable [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [Fintype J]

theorem joint_moment_naturality
    (P : V →ₗ[K] W) (L : W →ₗ[K] U) (c : J → K) (h : J → V) :
    L (∑ j, c j • P (h j)) = ∑ j, c j • (L.comp P) (h j) := by
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

theorem joint_dressing_naturality
    (L : W →ₗ[K] U) (D : J → V →ₗ[K] W) (h : J → V) :
    L (∑ j, D j (h j)) = ∑ j, (L.comp (D j)) (h j) := by
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.comp_apply]

end LinearMoments

section MultilinearContractions

variable {K I : Type*} [CommRing K] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
variable {V : I → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
variable {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
variable {J : I → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (J i)]

theorem all_flag_contraction
    (F : MultilinearMap K V W) (c : ∀ i, J i → K)
    (h : ∀ i, J i → V i) :
    F (fun i => ∑ j, c i j • h i j) =
      ∑ choice : ∀ i, J i,
        (∏ i, c i (choice i)) • F (fun i => h i (choice i)) := by
  rw [F.map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro choice _
  exact F.map_smul_univ (fun i => c i (choice i)) (fun i => h i (choice i))

end MultilinearContractions

end FamilyOrbitLocalization

claims.natural_statement: For every B,E in this context there are unique positive-filtration primary u_B,u_X and an upper symplectic R, identity modulo positive filtration, simultaneously factoring S_W=R S_bl and A_W(0)=c U_R(A_B,tw(u_B) A_X,tw(u_X)); rational expansion at zero has coefficientwise finite lower bound and both quantized actions exist. Actual integral curve labels are preserved; negative tautological degrees are not discarded.

external_assumptions.statement: The standard GW splitting, string, dilaton and topological-recursion identities give the overruled-cone tangent description and the normalized scalar two-point identity V(w,z)=S(w)^*S(z)/(w+z), also for inverse-Euler twisted theories with their twisted pairing. The full-cohomology tensor interpretation is explained in the report.
external_assumptions.source: Coates--Givental--Tseng, Virasoro constraints for toric bundles
